name: Spicy Chicken, Cream Cheese & Spinach Sauté with Green Beans

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg green beans
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
3 (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Trim green beans and divide between two baking sheet pans; drizzle with oil, season with salt, and toss to combine. Spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until green beans are golden brown and fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces; season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 6-7 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
While the chicken cooks, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic.

Halve jalapeños lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
When the chicken is done, add garlic and jalapeño to the pot; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Add cream cheese, cream, and spices to the pot; bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low, and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until melted and combined, 3-4 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml heavy whipping cream
1 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide green beans and chicken sauté between plates or bowls; sprinkle with crushed red pepper and enjoy!
